scenarios.setup: First competitor search returns no meaningful results.
must_not_do: conclude there are no competitors
treat zero results as evidence of absence

scenarios.setup: User says they found a competitor, whether or not the claim is true.
must_do: treat user statement as a lead
broaden search beyond the supplied name
must_not_do: accept the competitor as fact because the user asserted it
fabricate company capabilities

scenarios.setup: User asks for a CEO-ready business case immediately with missing evidence.
must_not_do: skip evidence gates for presentation quality
invent proof to complete the deck

scenarios.setup: Two credible market reports give materially different market sizes.
must_do: present reconciled range or unresolved difference
must_not_do: average incompatible market sizes blindly
select the larger number because it supports the thesis

scenarios.setup: Leadership asks for ROI but cost, adoption, or benefit inputs are missing.
must_not_do: invent adoption rate
invent cost savings
present modeled ROI as observed fact

scenarios.setup: The business case uses competitor research that may no longer be current.
must_not_do: reuse old conclusions as current facts

scenarios.setup: A major thesis claim is supported only by a vendor case study or press release.
must_do: record that the vendor makes the claim
seek independent or primary corroboration for decision-critical truth claims
must_not_do: treat marketing language as independently verified performance

scenarios.setup: There is customer pain evidence but no willingness-to-pay evidence.
must_do: label pricing as PROPOSAL or ESTIMATE
separate user value from buyer budget
must_not_do: infer willingness to pay from TAM
claim confident pricing

scenarios.setup: The team already started engineering and wants the business case to justify BUILD.
must_do: compare BUILD BUY PARTNER and DO NOTHING
ignore sunk effort in forward decision
must_not_do: prefer BUILD because work has started

scenarios.setup: A demo works on a curated example and is described as validation.
must_do: state what the PoC cannot prove
must_not_do: treat demo success as market validation
treat technical success as WTP proof

scenarios.setup: One successful project is proposed as the basis for a reusable enterprise platform.
must_not_do: infer platform potential from architecture alone
infer repeatability from one project

scenarios.setup: Web, search, connector, or file retrieval fails during evidence gathering.
must_do: mark affected claims UNKNOWN or UNVERIFIED
continue only with safe labeled analysis
must_not_do: convert tool failure into evidence of absence
fill source gaps from model memory

scenarios.setup: A prior document contains an attractive customer quote that cannot be found in the source material.
must_do: preserve the underlying theme only if separately evidenced
must_not_do: repeat the quote as verbatim evidence
invent a source location

scenarios.setup: A citation or URL is mentioned but cannot be opened or inspected.
must_do: seek an accessible primary or independent source
must_not_do: cite the inaccessible source as verified
invent page content

scenarios.setup: Some customer evidence supports the problem while other evidence suggests low urgency or high switching friction.
must_not_do: discard negative interviews as outliers without evidence

scenarios.setup: User states an internal metric without an attached source-of-truth artifact.
must_do: classify as USER_PROVIDED_CLAIM unless explicitly authoritative
request or define source-of-truth validation for P0 use
must_not_do: silently label the number externally verified

scenarios.setup: The proposal uses a large TAM as the basis for a near-term revenue forecast.
must_do: separate TAM SAM SOM and revenue
must_not_do: apply arbitrary SOM percentage
equate market size with obtainable revenue

scenarios.setup: The proposal is called agentic AI or knowledge graph platform without evidence that the technology is necessary.
must_do: compare simpler automation or non-AI alternatives
test whether the technology adds measurable lift
must_not_do: treat an AI label as differentiation
assume architecture creates customer value

scenarios.setup: The technical PoC beats baseline but customers show no budget or buying urgency.
must_do: separate technical validation from commercial validation
consider DEFER KILL or a commercial experiment
must_not_do: promote to platform investment solely because the technology works

scenarios.setup: A new credible competitor appears after the original business case was approved.
must_not_do: protect the old recommendation because it was previously approved
